messages:
vince: deploy-bot scheduled UNPIN runtime v2.9 -> v2.10 and SDK v2.0 -> v2.1 for canary tomorrow 05:00 UTC. tagging runtime/sdk/qa/sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduled actions: UNPIN runtime v2.9 -> v2.10 (canary) and UNPIN sdk v2.0 -> v2.1 (canary). Trigger: coordinated-release-window. ETA: 05:00 UTC.
runtime-kim: Heads-up: v2.10 includes a refactor of kernel alias resolution. We added a fallback map lookup for quantized binds. Need SDK to confirm ABI expectations for kv_bind API.
sdk-lin: SDK change in v2.1 expects runtime to expose `kv_bind_v3` alias for quant models; earlier we used a soft-fallback but relied on the runtime returning a compatible signature.
qa-jo: Quick local smoke: pairing sdk v2.1 with runtime v2.10 in staging causes intermittent failures in longseq: `TypeError: kv_bind() got unexpected keyword 'context_hint'`
qa-jo: Error snippet:
```
TypeError: kv_bind() got unexpected keyword 'context_hint'
  at bindings.py:134
```
sre-park: Impact estimate from telemetry: ~0.12% of traffic would hit that codepath during canary, concentrated in dedicated customers using longseq. Recommend cautious approach.
pm-ela: Product note: one active enterprise customer running longseq demos next week. We should avoid a noisy canary.
vince: Proposed immediate plan:
- PAUSE coordinated unpin until we validate runtime+SDK pairing.
- Runtime adds alias shim mapping old kv_bind signature -> new signature.
- SDK adds defensive adapter to accept both signatures in v2.1.
- Run a paired canary with both fixes.
deploy-bot: PAUSE unpin actions for thread 4123456789. Reason: compatibility check between runtime and SDK pending. (requested by vince)
runtime-kim: I can add a shim that registers `kv_bind_v2` pointing to `kv_bind_v3_adapter` in alias table; tiny change, PR in runtime open shortly.
sdk-lin: I'll add a compatibility wrapper in SDK that inspects callable signature and maps `context_hint` -> `ctx_hint` if needed. Will open PR and run unit tests.
qa-jo: Please add a CI smoke that runs `staging_pair_test.sh --runtime v2.10 --sdk v2.1 --profile longseq` to catch this before canary.
runtime-kim: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2250 "chore: alias shim kv_bind_v2 -> kv_bind_v3_adapter"
sdk-lin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/1045 "fix: compatibility wrapper for kv_bind context_hint"
qa-jo: Queued CI for both PRs; ETA combined ~40m. I'll also prepare a scoped paired canary that only touches 2% of longseq traffic.
sre-park: I'll add a temporary alert: kv_bind_typeerror_rate > 0.05% => page.
pm-ela: If we end up holding >30m, I'll notify the enterprise contact to avoid surprises.
qa-jo: CI green for runtime PR (4123458100). runtime:v2.10-hotfix-2250 built.
sdk-lin: SDK CI green (4123458200). sdk:v2.1-canary-1045 built.
qa-jo: Starting paired scoped canary at 05:35 UTC to 2% longseq cohort using runtime:v2.10-hotfix-2250 + sdk:v2.1-canary-1045.
qa-jo: First 15m check: no TypeErrors, token latency stable.
runtime-kim: Observing kernel alias table on canary nodes shows both aliases present and mapping to adapter.
sdk-lin: SDK logs confirm compatibility wrapper executed in canary cohort.
sre-park: Monitoring: kv_bind_typeerror_rate == 0 for cohort; no alerts triggered.
vince: If the canary stays green for 30m, we can resume staged unpins for both runtime and SDK. Otherwise roll back respective PRs.
qa-jo: Canary passed 30m window (4123459000). No regressions.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN actions: proceeding with staged canary -> remaining canary -> regional rollouts for both runtime and SDK per coordinated policy.
pm-ela: I'll update release notes: mention compatibility guard and paired rollout. Also add support KB for customers on longseq.
sdk-lin: Leaving deprecation notice in SDK changelog for `context_hint` mapping and an example for migration.
qa-jo: Closing paired compatibility thread after final rollout finishes. Good cross-team work.
